name: THE BARMAN
note: Errata 323, doc 133 (Tyler, 2026-11-14: "Add a barman"). Three lines speak of the Nugget's barman (he pays for the tuning, doc 57 A7; he watches Thad consider the bar, doc 49; he keeps the lamps trimmed) and nobody stood behind the bar. Drawn in one operation (reference/nugget-barman/handback.md) and softened to Thad's texture and contrast in the cut (errata 325). He stands behind the counter between the second and third drinkers, inside the bar's own hotspot, so a click on him is a click on the bar, whose lines already speak of him. No tree, no barks, no approach: like the drinkers, he is the room's population, and nothing about him is marked (invariant 9).
anchorNote: A BAND, like the drinkers: the sheet stops at the counter top's front edge, and (x, y) is that edge under him (the hand-back's anchor, cell (53, 142)). He is the room's standing man at the bar (246 px crown to hidden feet), cut where his hands meet the counter.
poseNote: Polishing a glass with a hand cloth, the towel over his shoulder. Only the two polishing frames are played (errata 325): the sheet's frames 2 and 3 (the glass set down; looking along the bar) lost the hand cloth that 0 and 1 hold, and errata 111 does not let a thing in his hands vanish. They stay on the sheet as drawn, unplayed.
barksNote: NONE. He says nothing of his own; the bar's lines are Thad's, and two of them are about him.

sprite.frameNote: 0 polish A · 1 polish B (the glass turned, the cloth moved). He polishes slowly between the two; every few seconds a break polishes harder. Cut at the room's scale, so drawn 1:1.
